name: smooth-caret-input
title: Smooth Caret Input
description: A pair of text inputs, one with a spring-animated caret that slides to each new spot and a plain input for comparison, so you can feel the difference while typing.
use: A search or command field is a focal point and a gliding caret adds a subtle polish.
avoid: The caret is a custom bar measured from the text, so long strings or unusual fonts can drift out of alignment.
a11y: The native input keeps full keyboard and screen reader behaviour; the custom caret is decorative and snaps under reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Two wide dark rounded fields stack under a small uppercase label. The top one is taller with large light text and a slim white caret bar; the lower one holds smaller grey placeholder text.
behaves: Focusing the top field reveals an outline, and typing makes the white caret glide to the new character instead of blinking at a jump. The native field below shows the ordinary caret for comparison.
customise: All normal input props pass through plus type, font size, a wrapper class and caret spring tuning; the measuring and scroll logic stays internal.
weight: light: One input plus a measured span and a spring value that runs only while the caret moves.
demo: Placeholders 'Search projects…' and 'Native caret'; typed text 'pricing table' and 'Ship it on Friday'.
polishWhy: The gliding caret is convincing and the comparison layout is clear; it is a small effect.
